title: पर्यटन प्रवद्र्धनमा पथ प्रदर्शकको भूमिका एक अध्ययन {A Study of the Role of Guides in Tourism Promotion}
nepali: पर्यटन वर्तमान समयमा आय आर्जन गर्ने महत्वपूर्ण एवम् बलियो स्रोत भएको छ । संसारका जुनसुकै मुलुकमा पनि आर्थिक उन्नति र प्रगकिो भरपर्दाे आधार पर्यटन बन्दै आएको छ । पर्यटन विकासका लागि रमणीय गन्तव्य भएर मात्र पुग्दैन । पर्यटकलाई यात्रामा सहयोगीको भूमिका निर्वाह गर्ने पथ प्रदर्शकको महत्व पनि उत्तिकै उल्लेखनीय हुने गर्दछ । पर्यटनका लागि पथ प्रदर्शक एउटा अनिवार्य जनशक्ति हो । सामान्यतः व्यक्ति आफूले जानेको, चिनेको, पुगेको स्थानमा भनदा पनि नजानेको नचिनेको र नपुगेको बिरामी गन्तव्यमा यात्रा गर्न मन पराउँदछ । यो मानवीय स्वभाव एवम् मनोविज्ञान नै हो । त्यसैले पर्यटनलाई एउटा अपरिचित ठाउँमा गरिने यात्रा भएकाले सम्बन्धित यात्रुलाई आवश्यक पर्ने अनेकन सुख सुविधाहरूमध्ये पथ प्रदर्शक पनि एउटा महत्वपूर्ण सुविधा भित्र पर्दछ । पथ प्रदर्शकको सहयोग एवम् सहायताले मात्र यात्रुले सही अर्थमा सम्बन्धित गन्तव्यका विषयमा जानकारी लिन सक्दछन् । सकेसम्मको फाइदा उठाउन सक्ने सम्भावना रहन्छ । फलस्वरूप पथ प्रदर्शक पर्यटनका लागि अनिवार्य आवश्यकता मानिएको हो । समग्रमा खास लेखमा पृष्ठभूमि, पथ प्रदर्शकको अर्थ, पथ प्रदर्शकका निम्ति चाहिने आधारभूत मापदण्ड, पथ प्रदर्शकको पालना गर्नुपर्ने आचार संहिता, पर्यटन प्रवद्र्धनमा पथ प्रदशकको भूमिका र उपशीर्षक भित्र पथ प्रदर्शकसँग सम्बन्धित विविध पक्षको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Tourism has become an important and robust source of income generation in present times. In any country around the world, tourism has been serving as a reliable foundation for economic advancement and progress. Having scenic destinations alone is not enough for tourism development. The importance of tour guides, who play the role of assistants to tourists during their travels, is equally noteworthy. A tour guide represents essential manpower for tourism. Generally, people prefer traveling to unfamiliar, unknown, and unvisited destinations rather than to places they already know, recognize, and have visited. This is simply human nature and psychology. Therefore, since tourism is travel undertaken to an unfamiliar place, a tour guide counts as an important amenity among the various comforts and facilities required by the traveler. Only with the help and assistance of a tour guide can travelers truly obtain information regarding the destination. There is a strong possibility of deriving the maximum possible benefit. Consequently, a tour guide is regarded as an indispensable necessity for tourism. Overall, this specific article analyzes the background, the meaning of a tour guide, the basic criteria required for a tour guide, the code of conduct a tour guide must observe, the role of a tour guide in tourism promotion, and diverse aspects relating to tour guides under various subheadings.

Having gorgeous spots to visit just isn't enough on its own to build up tourism. Having tour guides on hand to help travellers out on their trips is every bit as vital. A tour guide is an absolute must-have in terms of boots on the ground. Generally speaking, folk prefer heading off to unfamiliar, unvisited spots rather than sticking to places they already know inside out. That's just human nature and psychology in action. So, because tourism means heading off somewhere completely unfamiliar, having a guide is one of the most important comforts a traveller needs. As a result, having a tour guide is seen as an absolute necessity for tourism. All in all, this paper breaks down the background, what a tour guide actually is, the basic criteria needed, the code of conduct they've got to follow, their role in boosting tourism, and various other bits and bobs under subheadings.
